name: dt-sec-insights
description: Query Dynatrace security.events with DQL: vulnerabilities, threat detections, compliance posture. Covers Dynatrace-native Runtime Vulnerability Analytics (RVA — CVEs, reachability, exploit), Runtime Application Protection (RAP), Automated Detections, Security Posture Management (KSPM/CSPM), Dynatrace vulnerability feed, external tools. Trigger: "open critical vulnerabilities", "vulnerable functions in use and exposed", "top vulnerable libraries / K8s workloads", "vulnerabilities on this host", "CIS/DORA compliance pass rate", "SQL injection detections", "does Dynatrace know CVE-X / how is it fixed", "what is DTV-…", "new in the feed", "exploited in the wild (KEV)". Do NOT use for scan coverage, mapping external findings to workloads / entity mapping, or RVA verification of external findings (use dt-sec-contextualization), explaining DQL (dt-dql-essentials), Davis problems (dt-obs-problems), logs (dt-obs-logs), tracing (dt-obs-tracing), service metrics (dt-obs-services), platform audit (dt-platform).
